performance_operations.meaning: maintain a reference layer while other relations change
move one voice before or after another without shifting every voice equally
change one voice's subdivision family while preserving a perceptible reference
remove a voice while retaining its relational trace in the remaining field
turn phase conflict or an error into the next playable relation instead of rewinding
return only the released intervention toward the current reference, not every layer to a loop start

anti_patterns: one touch equals one independent completed track
automatic rewind to a stored loop start
adding voices whenever touch count increases
artist-branded presets as a substitute for relations
implementation_boundary: research model only; no product path or integration decision changed
